evidence: The state of the initial surface of the substrates and thickness of ultrathin (<100 nm) layers were determined using ellipsometry by measuring the polarization parameters Δ and Ψ on a laser ellipsometer with a wavelength of radiation λ = 623.8 nm and a pitch of the light beam onto the sample Θ = 68 °30´. The elemental composition of the obtained nanostructures was established according to the data of the X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPES) by comparing the experimental values of the binding energy (Eb) with the standard ones for a given compound. The structure of the obtained layers and their orientation were controlled by the electronographic and microdiffraction methods on a high-resolution electronograph EVR-100 and electron microscope EMV100BR.
